content:
The **Somerset Special** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*.

This weapon is a unique, Legendary .44 Pistol. It is modified with a scope, and has the legendary effect Anti-Armor baked in.

As the Somerset Special is a .44 pistol it can be modified to use any .44 Pistol mods.
